constructor.details: Reverts ZeroAddress if usdc_ is the zero address.

params.usdc_: ERC-20 token used for all transfers (6 decimals on Arc).

params.amount: USDC amount (6 decimals) to lock in escrow.
params.deadline: Timestamp after which payer may refund if still open.
params.payee: Recipient of funds on successful PASS attestation.
params.verifier: Signer authorized to attest PASS for this escrow.
params.workSpecHash: Hash of the agreed work specification.

returns._0: EIP-712 digest to be signed by verifier.

release(uint256,bytes32,bytes).details: Deadline is intentionally not checked; release stays possible until refunded.      EOA signatures are additionally checked for the low-s form (EIP-2) to reject      malleable s-flipped variants.  ERC-1271 smart-account signatures are not      constrained here because their isValidSignature logic is owner-defined.

params.deliverableHash: Hash of delivered work acknowledged by verifier signature.
params.signature: Verifier signature over EIP-712 PASS payload.

MIN_DEADLINE_SECS().notice: Minimum seconds from now that a deadline must be set to.

createEscrow(address,address,uint256,uin.notice: Create a new escrow and fund it with USDC from the payer.

nextEscrowId().notice: Next escrow id to allocate. First real escrow id is 1.

passDigest(uint256,bytes32).notice: Return EIP-712 digest expected for verifier PASS attestation.

refund(uint256).notice: Refund escrowed USDC back to payer once deadline has passed.

release(uint256,bytes32,bytes).notice: Release escrowed USDC to payee with a valid verifier PASS attestation.

usdc().notice: USDC token used for all escrow funding and payouts.
